text:
irina: heads-up — customer reported 413s on embeddings with our prefetch path when sending many tiny texts (avg 10 tokens) in a single request. first seen at 20:04:10 UTC
aj: do we hit payload byte limits or per-item quota?
chad: likely payload bytes: prefetcher concatenates, but splitter should have prevented large arrays. can you paste failing payload?
irina: paste: ```curl -X POST /v1/embeddings -d '{"input": ["a","b",...3000 entries]}'``` they had 2.1MB body, but each embedding < 512 dims
maria: 2.1MB shouldn't 413 — our nginx limit is 4MB. maybe an intermediate gateway? logs?
ops-bot: [monitoring] nginx-embed-gw returned 413 at 2026-03-18T20:04:12Z for req id abc123
aj: ah here's it — prefetch ledger tries to coalesce requests into a batched prefetched blob; we cap batch byte size at 1MiB for routing. if someone overrides, upstream will 413
sam: is this a config mismatch between hosted and dedicated defaults?
irina: customer on Dedicated, their infra patched in an older prefetcher (v0.9) that used 1MiB cap; new default is 2MiB. rollout mismatch.
chad: So we need a console warning + telemetry to show customers when prefetch policy is out of sync
maria: Agree. UX: in Console Route config page show "prefetch ledger cap" with detected runtime value vs configured. Flag for rollout to warn 7 days before enforcement
aj: For immediate mitigation: add graceful fallback — if we get 413 from gateway, respond 429 with guidance to split items and log vectorlen histogram for console
irina: also propose a small preflight check on upload that simulates coalescing and returns expected batches, used by SDKs and Console 'Validate' button
sam: Implementation plan: 1) runtime: map 413 -> soft-fallback 429 + header X-Embed-Split=1, 2) console: show mismatch, 3) telemetry: new meter 'embed.prefetch.cap_mismatch' + tag runtime_version
chad: can we get a quick dashboards query? `sum:embed.prefetch.cap_mismatch{env:prod} by customer`
ops-bot: created incident INC-4521 to track mitigation steps
maria: i'll own the console change. aj + chad can handle runtime + telemetry. irina to coordinate customer comms
irina: thanks. i'll ping the customer with an immediate workaround: set sdk param `max_batch_bytes=512000` and we'll follow up
sam: tiny followup — need e2e test: create dedicated with old prefetcher and run long-array upload to reproduce
aj: ack. will prototype patching 413->429 by EOD
maria: noted for design: need microcopy for console warning + docs snippet
irina: closing loop: once telemetry shows 0 mismatches for 48h we'll soft-enforce increase. :thumbsup:
